title: Long-term Monthly ESA CCI–DLR Average Snow Cover Probability, 2000–2025 at 500 m resolution
role: Exploratory spatial context, not calibrated route snow probability
recommended_map_title: Typical monthly snow cover — satellite ensemble (%)
statistic: p50 ensemble: equal-weight average of DLR and ESA CCI long-term calendar-month medians where both are valid at Utah latitude. One-source valid pixels use that source.
pixel_size_label: nominal 500 m; ESA source 1 km resampled to match DLR
method_notes: DLR: monthly percent of valid land observations classified snow-covered; water/invalid observations omitted from denominator.

Publisher describes ESA monthly snow-day fraction with a 10% snow-cover threshold; repository also computes mean daily snow-cover fraction. The published repository does not include the ESA long-term quantile step, so the precise ESA input variant is not independently reproduced.
The ensemble averages source medians, not a median of an annual combined dataset. It is not the pooled percentage of all calendar days, nor a trip probability.
Publisher README identifies the ESA component as 2000–2023 and DLR as 2000–2025. Do not claim both components cover all26 years.
No calibrated physical snow-depth threshold; never label this >=1 inch or compare numerically as same variable as NOAA station snow depth.
Zero median may occur despite snow in occasional years. Coarse pixels miss narrow shaded terrain and do not establish trail safety.
Publisher calls results initial with limited accuracy and potential location/harmonization errors; no local validation or count-of-valid-years raster supplied.
retrieval: gdal_translate -projwin -112.95 38.0 -111.4 36.75 -co COMPRESS=DEFLATE /vsicurl/<Zenodo API file content URL> <output>; no reprojection/resampling; HTTP byte ranges avoid full global downloads
